Multichannel Fluorescence Field

Source: R/figure-plots-images.R
PlotFluorescenceField.Rd

Composes an additive multichannel image from channel windows (a field as returned by segmantR::sg_read_field()), display levels and channel colours and weights (see CompositeFields() for the layer and level rules), and draws it at its physical extent with optional scale bar, corner text, arrows pointing at cells, crosses on partner cells and boxes.

Usage

PlotFluorescenceField(
  field,
  layers,
  slide = NULL,
  levels = NULL,
  marks = NULL,
  index = NULL,
  marks_index = NULL,
  gamma = 0.8,
  min_span = 1,
  interpolate = TRUE,
  arrow = NULL,
  cross = NULL,
  corner_text = NULL,
  corner_size = 5,
  corner_colour = "white",
  corner_at = c(0.04, 0.96),
  label = NULL,
  label_size = 5.5,
  scale_bar = list(length = 50, label = "50 um", colour = "white"),
  boxes = NULL,
  box_colour = "white",
  box_width = 0.6,
  box_size = NULL,
  frame = FALSE,
  style = ManuscriptStyle()
)

Arguments

field

A field (channels, centre, size) or a list of fields with index selecting one.

layers

List of channel layers (see CompositeFields()).

slide, levels

Optional range tables (channel, lo, hi).

marks

Optional data frame of cells to annotate (x, y, and for crosses partner_x, partner_y); marks_index selects rows.

index, marks_index

Optional selections.

gamma, min_span

Display gamma and minimum level span.

interpolate

Smooth the raster when scaling (bilinear).

arrow

NULL or a list: tip, tail (offsets from the cell along both axes, physical units), colour, linewidth (points), head (arrow-head scale in points) and shrink (points left free at both ends).

cross

NULL or a list: colour, size (marker area in square points), linewidth; drawn at the partner positions.

corner_text

NULL, a fixed text, or a list with column and format (sprintf) taking the value from the first mark.

corner_size, corner_colour

Corner text size and colour.

corner_at

Corner text position (fractions of the field, top-left anchored).

label

Optional field label in the top-left corner (as corner_text, larger).

label_size

Label size.

scale_bar, boxes, box_colour, box_width, box_size, frame

As in PlotCellMap().

style

A ManuscriptStyle() object.

Value

A 'grid' grob.

Examples

set.seed(3)
field <- list(channels = list(cd3 = matrix(runif(400, 0, 100), 20),
                              foxp3 = matrix(runif(400, 0, 100), 20)),
              centre = c(10, 10), size = 10)
g <- PlotFluorescenceField(field,
  layers = list(list(channel = "cd3", colour = "#00C8FF", lo = "q0.01", hi = "q0.99"),
                list(channel = "foxp3", colour = "#FF00C8", lo = "q0.5", hi = "q1",
                     overlay = TRUE)),
  scale_bar = list(length = 5, label = "5 um"))
grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(g)
